name: Ann Blair Thornton
why: Sharp, well-lit, smiling frame; she is the only named subject and the only face turned to the camera, wearing the Miss Kentucky crown and sash the caption describes. Cropped from a 1501x992 Herald photograph. NOTE FOR THE EDITOR: the archive already publishes a smaller crop (270x450) of this same photograph as 2009-10-ann-blair-thornton.jpg. years.json carries 'Ann Blair Thornton' (2008-09, member) and 'Ann-Blair Thornton' (2009-10, Secretary of the Senate) as two records, and they are almost certainly one person. If they are merged, keep this larger crop and drop the other; if they are not merged, this fills the 2008-09 record.
caption_quote: Bowling Green native Ann-Blair Thornton, the current Miss Kentucky and WKU student
